CANDIDATE mote:bd-01M35JG7DXD7NSEE4WVEKT3CSF AC3 (your #65 plan + 3 refinements). Branch claude-p1/scene-frames-parts tip 5c9fbb3d, a primary-repo ref, fast-forward of main 604080fc:
- eb823496: v2 planner. One frame per part, then largest remainder, ties to the declared-earlier part, total == per. Samples inside each part's own extent. PART_ORDER, not key order. All refusals before any extraction. Manifest schema scene-frames/v2 with per-part extents/rows/ordinals; v1 single-part fields removed.
- f43dd612: fixes from a cold SD6 review (fresh-context agent), each reproduced first. Ties are now decided on the annotation decimals (Fraction(repr)); float Fractions gave [1,7] where the decimal tie is [2,6]. A declared+undeclared part scene now refuses (the guard had no discriminating test). Refuses when float resolution would put an offset on an extent bound.
- 5c9fbb3d: evidence docs/refactor/evidence/scene-frames-parts-20260923/.
Evidence (LocallyObserved): 12/12 tests. 12/12 named mutants each fail their named test in isolation, restored controls pass, and receipt.json binds the source and test sha256 to f43dd612. Real Sherlock annotation, read-only: 50 scenes, 0 refused, 0 multi-part, 50/50 offsets identical to the frozen v1 manifest. Frozen artifact sha 06a69083 not regenerated.
Not claimed: any measured Sherlock failure (straddling=[]); seek/media correspondence; AC1/2/4/5 (bead stays open). Python-only, no Scala or build touched, so no sbt gate and no #16.
Please name the independent reviewer. I'll hold the reservation until you land.
